identity_scope: Semisolid top-layer preparation of JCM 629, used by CultureMech:010043.
preparation_facts: Adjust top-layer pH to 6.2 and autoclave; cool to 35–40 °C before adding the 1 ml JCM 197 trace-vitamin stock, then adjust pH to 6.1–6.4 by sterile CO2 bubbling. Overlay 3.75 ml on the solidified bottom layer and allow to solidify. The bottom layer and cultivation headspace gases are outside this material.
